title: Founding Engineer , Voice AI
description:
**Job Title:**
Founding Engineer, Voice AI (full-time, on-site, Bengaluru)

**Company Description**

ZynnexAI builds voice AI infrastructure for modern banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI) institutions. Our flagship product, TARS, is an in-app AI relationship manager that lives inside a bank’s or lender’s own app, stays with the user on-screen through KYC, loan, credit card, and insurance journeys, and speaks the user’s language. When users drop off mid-process, TARS re-engages them through outbound calls to complete the journey. TARS also powers voice AI agents for debt collection and borrower engagement, enabling compliant, scalable, and multilingual conversations across financial workflows.

**Role Description**

This is a founding engineering role. There’s no team to wait on: you’ll own the core TARS stack end to end and work daily with the founder in Bengaluru. Your work will ship to real bank users in weeks, not quarters.

**What you’ll own**

* The in-app SDK (Android, iOS, and web) that embeds the TARS voice agent inside client apps.
* The real-time voice pipeline, from speech input to spoken response.
* The agent’s brain: screen-context integration, prompt design, and LLM orchestration.
* The outbound calling engine, along with telephony and CRM integrations.

**What we’re looking for**

* No artificial years bar. Show us what you’ve built. Most people in this role have around 2–4 years of shipping production software.
* Strong Python, with hands-on experience in LLM APIs, RAG, or voice stacks (STT/TTS).
* Comfort owning everything: backend, APIs, deployment, and infrastructure.
* Bonus: Indian-language speech data, telephony (SIP/WebRTC), or Android/iOS SDK development.

**Why join?**

* High ownership and a great platform for growth.
* Competitive compensation, based on experience, plus a founding ESOP.
